title: Zun`Muram Tkarish Zyk
summary: Maintain tank coverage through Zun`Muram's banishments while suppressing ritualist reinforcements.
overview: Maintain tank coverage through Zun`Muram's banishments while suppressing ritualist reinforcements.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep a backup tank ready for banishment and free jailed players promptly.
Assign ritualist kills to stop their recurring waves.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A check every twenty-five seconds can banish the top-threat target to a northern or southern jail.
Leaving a player in jail for twenty seconds brings six apparitions into that room.
Four ritualists begin staggered reinforcement waves after thirty, sixty, ninety and 120 seconds, then repeat every two minutes while their ritualist survives.
The boss, inquisitors and ritualists share aggression; the main chamber boundary resets targets pulled outside it.

notes: Approval E384. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
